MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The roll-pin assortment fits my repeated purchases of rivets, nuts, bolts and cotter pins: having several sizes available helps me handle different mechanical repairs.",
    "Heat shrink, rubber grommets and repair glue complement my drilling supplies, adhesives and resin by helping me protect wiring and finish small repairs. The grommet sizes would still need to fit my project."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "Another inspection camera repeats a capability I already have with my triple-lens Teslong; I need a clear additional benefit before buying a replacement.",
    "The circuit tester and suction lifters require specific jobs I have not indicated I am doing. Recycling bins and crowd-control ropes have no clear connection to my recent hands-on projects.",
    "The magnets could suit a workshop project, but that general usefulness is not enough for me to choose them now without a need for that size."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "My purchases of repair tools seem to have been stretched into an interest in almost any industrial or commercial equipment.",
    "My earlier inspection-camera purchase seems to have been treated as a reason to buy another, without considering that I may already have that need covered."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My repeated fastener-assortment purchases suggest I value practical supplies in multiple sizes that support a range of repairs.",
    "Supplies that work with tools I already own feel more useful than another durable tool serving the same purpose.",
    "A specialized tool needs a matching project, and even a relevant supply needs suitable dimensions before I would choose it."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations understood my interest in repair supplies but stretched it too far toward duplicate tools and equipment for jobs I have not shown a need to do."
}
